intro.text: This entry describes brain small vessel disease-4 (BSVD4), which Rutten et al. (2024) presented as a novel hereditary cerebral small vessel disease.

checks.claim: Rutten et al. (2024) presented brain small vessel disease-4 (BSVD4) as a novel hereditary cerebral small vessel disease.
checks.evidence_quote: NIT1-small vessel disease is a novel, autosomal recessively inherited cerebral small vessel disease characterized by a triad of movement disorders, massively dilated basal ganglia perivascular spaces, and intracerebral hemorrhage.
checks.explanation: The paper presents NIT1-small vessel disease as a novel inherited (autosomal recessive) cerebral small vessel disease. 'BSVD4' is OMIM's name for this disorder and only restates the paper's term in standard nomenclature.

references.label: Rutten et al. (2024)
references.citation: Rutten JW, Cerfontaine MN, Dijkstra KL, Mulder AA, Vreijling J, Kruit M, Koning RI, de Bot ST, van Nieuwenhuizen KM, Baelde HJ, and others. Bi-allelic NIT1 variants cause a brain small vessel disease characterized by movement disorders, massively dilated perivascular spaces, and intracerebral hemorrhage. Genet Med 26: 101105, 2024. [PubMed: 38430071]
